name: Nanporo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nanporo town emblem in red: a broken ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Nanporo, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 June 1964.

features.role: Nanporo town emblem — a broken ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character
